_readme: THE config file — everything you might switch lives here. (1) Switch page: set pageId (or igUsername) + a FRESH metaUserToken (Graph API Explorer) and push; the agent mints the new page's permanent token on the next run and saves it to pageAccessToken automatically. (2) pageAccessToken: permanent page token — posting keeps working even after metaUserToken expires (page tokens never expire). (3) Pause everything: set autoPost to false (the GitHub Actions runner reads it live; force runs still work). (4) Schedule: slots + timezone.
